context:
Snowflake Iceberg: Use CREATE ICEBERG TABLE or ALTER TABLE ... SET TABLE_FORMAT = ICEBERG
with external volume pointing to staged data.  Reference Snowflake docs for Iceberg
Tables support.

ClickHouse Iceberg: Use iceberg() table function to read Iceberg data from S3/GCS.
Example: SELECT * FROM iceberg('s3://bucket/path/', ...) to create table from Iceberg.

Delta support for both platforms is lower priority - Iceberg is the primary open table
format for both.
description:
Snowflake and ClickHouse both support open table formats on the platform but their
BenchBox adapters only load parquet/CSV.  These platforms were removed from
DELTA_CAPABILITY and ICEBERG_CAPABILITY in format_capabilities.py (commit 9be7d5b70)
to prevent the fail-fast check from passing when loading would fail.

Completed closure:
- Snowflake external Iceberg now maps staging_root into BASE_LOCATION and only
  advertises support when the required external volume config is present.
- ClickHouse capability registration now distinguishes ClickHouse Cloud from
  ClickHouse Local/Server in format selection.
- Snowflake Delta remains external-mode only and is advertised only when the run
  has the required external-table configuration.
